description: Compare the network's live node, runtime, indexer API and proof server with Midnight's support matrix, and a project's Midnight packages (package.json and package-lock.json) with the matrix pins. data.localProject says which directory was checked and whether it had a package.json, and data.examples whether Midnight's own examples pass on the node the network runs.

checkLocalPackages.description: Check the project's packages at all (default true)

network.description: Midnight network to query: preview, preprod, mainnet, local

projectDir.description: Absolute path of the user's project; defaults to the server's working directory, which may not be the project

name: versions
title: midnight-cast versions
